Mrs. Fisher: Eh… It seems like a failure again.
You: You can tell? How? I don’t remember anything…
Mrs. Fisher: I just sort of look at your miserable face. 
You: …
Mrs. Fisher: Are you sure you are taking this seriously? 
You: How am I supposed to answer that?!
#mrsfisher.Eyes.NormalClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Go home and take a break. You need it.
You: Whatever…
